L Lg n1 n2
NMOS M1 n3 n2 n4 VSS

C Ct1 n3 n5

rationale: The proposed topology introduces a source degeneration inductor (Ls) and a shunt feedback capacitor (Ct2) to enhance input matching (S11) and noise figure (NF), while maintaining gain (S21) and power efficiency. The inductor Ls improves the input impedance transformation, reducing reflection, and the feedback capacitor stabilizes the gain and improves NF by reducing the effective transconductance at the input. The topology remains fully differential-friendly and respects the 45nm CMOS process constraints with no floating nodes.
